stories.headline: Savannah man indicted for trafficking a woman with a developmental disability for sex
stories.body: A grand jury indicted 20-year-old Joseph Chequan White on a charge of trafficking a person for sexual servitude, accusing him of providing a woman with a developmental disability for sex on June 12, 2026. White, who also has an outstanding hold from neighboring Bryan County, has not entered a plea, and no additional victims or arrests have been reported in the case.
